**Julian Richard Payne** is a British principal designer for Hot Wheels and Matchbox who has been working at Mattel since 1998. Most of his work is with regards to playsets, mainly [Color Shifters](/wiki/Color_Shifters) playsets, with some amount of vehicle design as well. He was a part of the Matchbox design team early on in his career but has since moved back.
